_schema: One JSON file per part category (parts.md). Every field here is load-bearing: if a spec does not feed the physics, it does not belong in this file yet. 'arm_mm' is centre-to-motor and is the sleeper spec — it is squared in the parallel axis theorem, so a 7" frame has roughly 4x the roll inertia of a 3" from geometry alone. 'max_prop_inches' and 'motor_mount' drive compatibility warnings only; Lothal warns, it never blocks.
